content: Our model architecture is based on Bi-LSTM-CRF, as shown in Fig. . The model is divided into three modules. The first, low-level module, consists of two separate structures: local and distant structures. The second, high-level module, contains a sequence of stacked bidirectional LSTM and self-attention layers. The final module, the prediction module, is responsible for predicting the tags INLINEFORM0 . Each module is described more completely in the next three subsections.
